Here is a Python function that can be used to return the input text in uppercase:

```python
def return_upper_text(text):
    return text.upper()

# Example
input_text = "Hello, World!"
output_text = return_upper_text(input_text)
print(output_text)
```

This function takes a string as input and returns the uppercase version of the text using the `upper()` method. You can call this function with any input text and it will return the uppercase version of it.
